run.ground_truth: Video A uses a two-step breading process: first coating chicken in flour before dipping in egg and quinoa mixture. Video B skips the flour stage entirely, directly dipping chicken in egg then panko breadcrumbs. The flour in Video A creates a base layer that helps the quinoa adhere, while Video B achieves crispiness through seasoned panko applied directly to the egg-washed chicken.
